name: pi
description: Run Claude Code subagents on the pi coding agent, with any pi provider and model.

piPath.title: pi executable
piPath.description: Path or name of the pi binary (resolved on PATH).

isolate.title: Isolate pi subagents
isolate.description: Run pi with --no-extensions, --no-prompt-templates and --no-themes so your interactive pi packages don't change subagent behaviour.

background.title: Background pi runs
background.description: auto: run in the background when the Agent call sets run_in_background, or when this session's Agent tool has no run_in_background parameter (so a long run can't block the turn). always: every pi run is a background task. never: every pi run is in the foreground with a live row.

stallTimeoutSec.title: Stall timeout (seconds)
stallTimeoutSec.description: A pi run that gets nothing from the model for this long while waiting on it counts as stalled (a stuck provider, common on OpenRouter): pi is stopped and the run resumes in a fresh pi session. Doubles on each retry.

stallRetries.title: Stall retries
stallRetries.description: How many times a stalled run (or one that hit a transient provider error such as a timeout or 502) is resumed in a fresh pi session, keeping its progress. Every /pi fallback model gets a retry of its own. 0 turns retrying off.

idleTimeoutSec.title: Idle timeout (seconds)
idleTimeoutSec.description: Kill a pi run whose tool (e.g. a long bash command) prints nothing for this long, and report it as hung.

maxRunMinutes.title: Wall-clock cap (minutes)
maxRunMinutes.description: Kill any pi run that is still going after this long.
